mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_session (workspace_id, created_by_user_id, title, visibility, status) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{createdByUserId}, #{title}, #{visibility}, #{status})
mapper.update:
UPDATE ai_chat_session
title = #{title},
status = #{status}, archived_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'archived' THEN COALESCE(archived_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ELSE NULL END,
visibility = #{visibility},
WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_session_participant (workspace_id, session_id, user_id, status, joined_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{sessionId}, #{userId}, 'joined', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))

INSERT INTO ai_chat_session_participant (workspace_id, session_id, user_id, invited_by_user_id, status, invited_at, joined_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{invitedByUserId}, 'invited', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT recipient.user_id FROM ( SELECT s.created_by_user_id AS user_id FROM ai_chat_session s WHERE s.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND s.id = #{sessionId} AND s.created_by_user_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT p.user_id FROM ai_chat_session s JOIN ai_chat_session_participant p ON p.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND p.session_id = s.id AND p.status = 'joined' WHERE s.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND s.id = #{sessionId} AND s.visibility = 'shared' ) recipient ORDER BY recipient.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_message (workspace_id, session_id, seq, author_kind, author_user_id, content, structured_json, input_tokens, output_tokens) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{sessionId}, #{seq}, #{authorKind}, #{authorUserId}, #{content}, #{structuredJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{inputTokens,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{outputTokens,jdbcType=INTEGER})
INSERT INTO ai_chat_turn (workspace_id, session_id, requested_by_user_id, status) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{sessionId}, #{requestedByUserId}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, session_id, requested_by_user_id, status, terminal_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_chat_turn WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND status IN ('queued', 'running') ORDER BY id ASC FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_tool_call (workspace_id, message_id, tool_name, status, arguments_json, idempotency_key) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{messageId}, #{toolName}, #{status}, #{argumentsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{idempotencyKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
